resources.string: Each time you return to home, at most every six hours, the app checks GitHub, downloads a new release automatically and says on home when it is ready. Select this row to check again or install it. Android asks you to confirm installation.
Version %1$s is ready. If Android asks, allow this app to install updates, then select Install again.
Downloading version %1$s. The download continues in the background.
This APK has a different signing key. To move from an older personal test build, follow the installation guide on the Releases page. Uninstalling removes local settings and login.
The update file is invalid and will not be installed. Check again.
An Android package installer is not available on this device.
Open github.com/soeleia/30namaTV/releases on your phone or computer.
The update check or download failed. Check your connection and retry.
Version %1$s is ready. Press OK to install, Back to dismiss.
Settings, version %1$s is ready to install
